integrity: The claims use published foundational results and a self-contained proof of the new stability, classification and obstruction statements. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The closure theorem assumes finitely many pairwise commuting positive operators and a coordinatewise nondecreasing bounded Borel function.
The complete noncommuting classification concerns mixtures of two orthogonal projections, not arbitrary positive operators.
Finite computer checks support exact identities only; proofs of infinite-dimensional claims are analytic.
A broader classical projection-algebra or well-quasi-order result might implicitly entail this specialization; definitive publication priority is not asserted.
Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Commuting stability and two-projection rigidity for reducing-minimum operators
